user.title: Connect your Wolt account
user.description: Paste a Wolt refresh token. Get it from a login nothing else will keep using: open a private window, log in at wolt.com, copy the refresh-token cookie from DevTools → Application → Cookies, then close the private window. Wolt rotates this token on every use and only the newest copy stays valid, so a browser that keeps refreshing it would log Home Assistant out.

reauth_confirm.title: Wolt needs a new login
reauth_confirm.description: Wolt rejected the stored refresh token. Log in again in a private window, copy the new refresh-token cookie, close the window and paste the value here.

error.invalid_auth: Wolt rejected this token. Copy a fresh one from a new private-window login.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Wolt. Check the connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Wolt account is already set up.
